policy: Treat each artwork-destination relationship as a distinct edge. Multiple works can match each target, and each work can match multiple targets.
Respect decision precedence: explicit later owner locks > earlier owner placement decisions > accepted alternatives > contextual reuse > Claude proposals > research leads.
Accepted alternatives do not change the active painting or authorize auto-rotation.
Prayer and Rosary protected covers/stage behavior remain unchanged. Rosary mystery image stays fixed throughout the decade.
Subject-based selections never silently become Calendar date or Prayer-slot placements.
A selected artwork is not a licence or exact photograph release authorization; source, rights, pixel and mobile QA gates remain separate.
Global rejected IDs are excluded only for the exact original/verified identity. Placement-specific rejection must not globally reject artwork.
No image acquisition, new app assignments, deployment or Vercel activity.
key_rule: No automatic deduplication of distinct physical works or artworkID aliases; each relationship points to its own source record.
